---
name: Implementation task
about: Define one implementation outcome with clear scope and completion checks.
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem and user flow

<!-- Explain the current gap, who encounters it, and a concrete use case.
     For internal tooling, describe the operator or developer workflow. -->

## Expected outcome

<!-- Describe the observable behavior when the work is complete. -->

## Scope and approach

<!-- Bound the change and name existing code/components to reuse. Include
     constraints and exclusions that matter; avoid prescribing unneeded design.
     For an investigation, state the question and evidence needed to resolve it. -->

## Baseline and code pointers

<!-- Relevant files/functions and any required branch/commit or prerequisite
     implementation, especially when the feature has not reached main. -->

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] <!-- A concrete pass/fail outcome. -->
- [ ] <!-- Relevant failure/recovery behavior, when applicable. -->

## Validation

<!-- Specify meaningful automated checks and/or a manual walkthrough, including
     relevant error cases. Identify external setup needed to run them. Actual
     results and remaining limitations belong in the implementation PR. -->

## Relationships (optional)

<!-- Link parent/related issues and genuine blockers. Use native GitHub
     parent/sub-issue and blocking relationships as well as these references.
     For a parent tracker, list sub-issues and the overall completion criteria. -->
